Package index

Data

The pooled, stimulus-level CFA-WM working memory dataset (v1/v2/v3) and its accessor.

all_data
Working memory strategies experiment (CFA-WM) combined dataset (v1, v2, v3)
get_data()
Get CFA-WM data, optionally filtered by version

Data preparation

Functions used once to compute the final scores used for later analyses.

compute_scores()
Compute WM-FTT recall scores
score_angular()
Angular similarity via cosine
score_word()
Word-recall similarity (Gonthier 2022 edit-distance scoring)
normalise_word()
Normalise a string for edit-distance comparison
damerau_levenshtein()
Damerau-Levenshtein distance (optimal string alignment)

Compositional analysis

Building the three-part relative-allocation composition and moving it off the simplex into ILR coordinates.

compose_features()
Responders-only compositional parts
ilr_coords()
Isometric log-ratio coordinates for a three-part composition
engaged_ids()
Participants clearing the engagement thresholds
wm_thresholds()
Minimum responded items per feature

Modelling

Shared Bayesian fitting defaults and posterior reporting, matching the aphantasiaEmotions package, plus the model specifications themselves. Formulas and priors are exported so that a script and a vignette use the same object: models are loaded with file_refit = "never", and brms does not check that the formula it is handed matches the one the cached fit was built with.

fit_brms_model()
Fit a Bayesian model using the brms package with default settings
report_rope()
Summarise posterior draws against a ROPE
joint_formula()
The joint propensity and accuracy model
joint_priors()
Priors for the joint model
performance_formula()
The per-feature performance model
composition_formula()
The compositional model
composition_priors()
Priors for the compositional model
response_priors()
Coefficient-wise priors for one response
feature_family()
Response families used for each recall feature
squeeze_boundaries()
Smithson-Verkuilen squeeze
lkj_marginal()
Marginal prior on a single correlation under an LKJ prior

Analysis helpers

Quantities computed identically by the working scripts and by the vignettes that report them.

split_half_reliability()
Split-half reliability of a per-feature score
spearman_brown()
Spearman-Brown correction
correlation_test()
Spearman correlation with its sample size
cronbach_alpha()
Cronbach's alpha
mars_knots()
MARS knot search, on participant means
composition_summary()
Descriptive summary of the compositional parts
centred_correlations()
Correlations between features after removing each participant's level
partition_variance()
Variance carried by each ILR coordinate, under each partition
posterior_correlations()
Participant-level correlations from a multivariate model

Questionnaire structure

The exploratory strand: preparing the questionnaire scales for clustering, and checking that a clustering means what it appears to.

questionnaire_scales()
The questionnaire scales, in one participant-level frame
standardise_scales()
Scale scores, standardised for combining
add_imagery_composite()
Collapse the imagery scales into one composite
cluster_stability()
Is a clustering of the pooled sample the same clustering of v1?
adjusted_rand_index()
Adjusted Rand index

Figures

The plotting identity shared with aphantasiaEmotions, plus the composition-specific figures.

theme_pdf()
Theme for elegant scientific vector figures
save_ggplot()
Custom ggsave wrapper set with Nature's formatting guidelines (width-locked)
scale_x_vviq()
Custom x-axis scale for VVIQ scores
scale_discrete_feature()
Custom discrete scale for the three WM-FTT features
scale_x_aphantasia()
Custom x-axis scale for imagery groups
scale_discrete_aphantasia()
Custom discrete scale for imagery groups
scale_shape_aphantasia()
Custom shape scale for imagery groups
plot_composition_ternary()
Ternary diagram of the three-part WM-FTT composition
plot_composition_biplot()
Centred log-ratio biplot of the WM-FTT composition
plot_split_half()
Split-half reliability, per feature
plot_floor_group()
Figure for a floor-group model
plot_vviq_histogram()
Marginal histogram of imagery vividness
